text:
alex: heads-up: planning to flip `response-smoothing` during the 03:00 UTC change window to reduce hallucination bursts. posting ramp + abort criteria for quick ack.

sam: thumbs-up. please include model pin details and what the deploy-bot does on rollback.

alex: plan: preflight checks at T-15m, enable canary cohort (canary-a) at 1% for 4m, then 4% for 6m, 15% for 10m, 40% for 12m, then 100% if all gates pass. holdpoints at every step.

deploy-bot: queued toggle job for 2025-02-14T03:00:00Z. will run preflight health checks (cpu/memory/latency/p95) and post events to #eng-oncall. dry-run successful.

nina: abort criteria proposal: P95 latency increase > 450ms absolute OR delta error rate > 0.6% OR top-k quality eval drop > 4 points. Also auto-pause if cost_per_token > baseline * 1.25.

alex: ack on abort guards. add a cold-cache warmup check: validate `kv.hits_ratio` > 0.7 after 2m else pause.

sam: pinning: on canary nodes we'll route model -> `embedder-3.4` with sticky sessions kept for 60s. If rollback, routing will repoint to `embedder-3.3` and we'll evict new pods via drain API. @deploy-bot confirm.

deploy-bot: confirm: canary routing pin to model:embedder-3.4, sticky TTL 60s, rollback sequence: disable-flag -> re-pin -> drain pods -> emit event. Will include `runbook_url` in event metadata.

ops-bot: FYI added escalation policy: if rollback triggered twice in one week, auto-open SRE review ticket.

alex: small tweak: add cost guard early-stop at 15% if token spend rate jump > 20% sustained for 10m.

nina: add a test harness: run 200 synthetic prompts from `repro/cases/burst_regressions` at each holdpoint to validate quality. fail deployment if > 6 failing prompts.

sam: ops ack. I'll be on-call for the window. ping me 20m before.

alex: scheduled toggle 03:00 UTC, pinging #eng-oncall at 02:40 UTC. release notes draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/releases/2025-02-14-response-smoothing.

deploy-bot: canary enable executed at 2025-02-14T03:00:00Z for cohort=canary-a. event_id=ee7c21.

alex: 03:02 preflight logs look clean. `kv.hits_ratio`=0.78. starting 1% run.

nina: 03:07 1% -> pass synthetic tests (0 fails). bump to 4%.

deploy-bot: ramped to 4% at 2025-02-14T03:08:00Z.

sam: 03:20 15% holdpoint: latency +30ms, errors flat, quality eval delta -1.2; below thresholds, continuing to 40%.

alex: note: cost_per_token +18% at 15% but below 20% early-stop. continuing.

ops-bot: monitoring rule `cost-spike` triggered a warning at 03:32 but not an abort. alert posted to #eng-releases.

deploy-bot: ramped to 40% at 2025-02-14T03:35:00Z.

nina: 40% synthetic tests: 3 fails (out of 200) -> still within 6 fail threshold. proceeding to 100% after 12m soak.

sam: rolling health green. ready for final.

deploy-bot: final rollout to 100% executed at 2025-02-14T03:50:00Z. event_id=ee7c21-2.

alex: closing thread. will post postmortem stub and attach telemetry charts (latency/cost/quality) and the synthetic test logs.

sam: thanks team. good coordination. :rocket:
